note: Rule-based starting dispositions for the ASVS matrix. 'features' entries apply NOT APPLICABLE only when the reviewer declares the feature absent (false) in asvs_features.json. 'host' and 'documentation' entries apply NEEDS VERIFICATION. Reviewer overrides always win. No rule ever produces PASS.

file_handling.reason: No file upload, file serving or archive handling in scope.

own_authentication.reason: Scope implements no authentication; the host framework authenticates users (not assessed).

own_sessions.reason: Scope implements no session or session-token management; the host framework does (not assessed).

self_contained_tokens.reason: No self-contained tokens (JWT/SAML-like) are issued or consumed.

oauth_oidc.reason: No OAuth/OIDC client, authorization server or resource server in scope.

cryptography.reason: Scope implements no cryptography of its own (transport TLS is provided by the platform HTTP client).

ldap_xpath_latex_regex_building.reason: No LDAP, XPath, LaTeX or dynamic regular-expression construction from untrusted data.

sets_cookies.reason: Scope sets no cookies of its own (host framework cookies not assessed).

user_supplied_urls.reason: No user-supplied URL is fetched server-side; outbound hosts are fixed.

rich_text_and_templates.reason: No user-supplied SVG, scriptable templates or template injection surface.

jndi_memcache_mail.reason: No JNDI, memcache or direct mail composition from untrusted input.

postmessage_cross_origin.reason: No CORS-preflight contract, multi-host isolation or postMessage use.

internal_service_tls.reason: No internal service-to-service channel or mTLS in scope.

proxy_ip_handling.reason: Scope does not implement proxy/middleware IP handling.

host.reason: Host/web-server/platform control (headers, TLS, egress, logging infrastructure); verify on the deployed system.

documentation.reason: Requires design/policy documentation that is not in the selected scope.

default.reason: Not separately assessed; no direct evidence recorded.
default.follow_up: Assess at runtime or with design evidence.
